digest.component_or_area: reconciler domain — operation outcome and retry budget
propositions: Define immutable logical_id, Disposition, FailureScope, ReplaySafety, and DelaySource enums with exact member sets to establish provider-neutral operation contract

Implement retry budget limiting physical invocations to at most three with cumulative sleep capped at 15,000 ms, using fake-clock scheduling with additive jitter formula [2**(retry_index+1)+U[0,1)) seconds
Canonically serialize outcome values through rebar._store.canonical.canonical_bytes to produce byte-identical compact UTF-8 JSON for equivalent outcomes
Construct and redact diagnostic entries via rebar.llm.failure.sanitize_diagnostic allowlist, truncate messages to 512 Unicode code points, overflow eighth diagnostic with sentinel entry

After ambiguous writes, observe desired primary-store postcondition before replay; observed desired state returns recovered, inconclusive observation returns non-replaying commit_unknown with ReplaySafety.forbidden
Authoritative provider delays act as sleep lower bounds never shortened; reject over-budget provider delays returning retry_not_before without incrementing invocation or request totals
